|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Target opponent's device or weapon card (except any Superlaser). Draw destiny (subtract 1 for each of your spies on table). If destiny < target's destiny number, target is lost. OR Cancel the targeting of a permanent weapon at same site as your spy.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Sabotage (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Target an opponent’s device or non-superlaser weapon card. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny -X < target’s destiny number, where X = the number of your spies on table. OR Cancel the targeting of a [[Permanent Weapon]] weapon at same site as your spy.” '''What changed:''' “opponent's” → “an opponent’s”; added “non-superlaser”; “card (except any Superlaser).” → “card.”; added “destiny. Target lost if”; “(subtract 1 for each” → “-X < target’s destiny number, where X = the number”; “table). If destiny < target's destiny number, target is lost.” → “table.”; “permanent” → “Permanent Weapon”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 17. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Sabotage]].
* Later text: [[Sabotage (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Sabotage (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Sabotage]].
